name: HILLSBORO 2-PERSON INDOOR STEAM SAUNA
description: The Hillsboro is an elegant 2-person indoor sauna that is ideal for placement where space is limited. Horizontal and vertical sections of heartwood spruce combine to create a beautiful and healthful accent to your home. For added placement flexibility, this freestanding traditional sauna by Almost Heaven Saunas can be assembled with the door and heater on either the left or right hand sides of the sauna.
